outlook.statement: The company is exploring opportunities to expand its business in other geographies of the country and outside.
The management remains committed to improving cost efficiencies and strengthening overall financial performance.

The outlook for the Indian packaging sector remains positive over the medium to long term. Growth in the beverage, food, pharmaceutical and consumer goods sectors is expected to support demand for packaging products. The increasing preference for packaged and branded products, coupled with urbanisation, organised retail and changing consumption patterns, is expected to provide opportunities for the packaging industry. However, the Company remains cognisant of the challenges arising from raw material price volatility, competitive pressures, regulatory changes and increasing sustainability requirements. The Company will continue to focus on strengthening its existing business, improving operational efficiency, controlling costs and identifying opportunities for sustainable and profitable growth.
